title: Illustration of the mounting position
body_md: Three images stand side by side. On the left the device is shown with its labelled top face upwards, circled in green: the correct position. In the middle the same device lies top face down, circled in red and struck through: the incorrect position. On the right a line drawing of a motorhome shows the external antenna near the dashboard being reached by a satellite symbol. Correct and incorrect are distinguished **solely** by colour and the strike-through; there is no caption.
source_region: Section 1.1, three illustrations in the lower third
prev_context: Before this stands the paragraph on the external GPS antenna.
next_context: Section 1.2 begins on the next page.
change_reason: Extracted from the English source page itself, not translated from the German master, and cross-read against the German page 7: identical, unchanged illustrations without any labelling. The purely colour-based distinction is therefore confirmed in both versions and is put into words here because it would otherwise be lost for colour-blind readers.
